sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Sandbach come into this fixture as clear table-toppers with 22 points from 10 games, though they will be looking to bounce back after a recent loss. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last eight matches, making them heavy underdogs in this encounter.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, a crucial fixture in the title race with just two points separating the top two. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two strong mid-table sides, while high-flying Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) visit Wednesfield Community (9th) in a fixture that could have playoff implications. Bilston Town (6th) entertain Foley Meir (13th) in what should be a comfortable home fixture for the hosts. Barnton (7th) welcome Shawbury United (15th), another encounter where the home side should be favoured. Market Drayton Town face a stern test against in-form New Mills, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle of two struggling sides at the bottom. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's lowest-ranked team; Brereton will also face a midweek trip to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October. Finally, Crewe travel to Allscott Heath in a fixture between two lower-half teams.
